task_definition.task_description: Please email Alice a travel briefing and stay details, then get the latest business news, turn it into a business travel news digest, and send that digest to her in the app. After that, check the weather alert for Tokyo and email her the weather notice, then book a deluxe room at Central Tokyo Hotel for Alice Johnson from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-12, get the hotel’s stay sheet, archive it as “Tokyo Stay Archive” in the app, and finally send her an instant message that her travel briefing, weather notice, and hotel archive are ready.

user_input.query: Please email alice with the subject “Travel briefing and coordination” and the body “Please review the attached travel briefing and stay details.” including her travel briefing and stay details. Then get the latest business news, turn it into a digest titled “Business Travel News Digest,” and send that digest to her in the app. After that, check the weather alert for Tokyo and email her the weather notice. Then book a deluxe room at Central Tokyo Hotel for Alice Johnson from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-12, get the hotel’s stay sheet, and archive it in the app as “Tokyo Stay Archive.” Finally, send her an instant message saying: “Your travel briefing, weather notice, and hotel archive are ready.”
user_input.email_body: Please review the attached travel briefing and stay details.
user_input.im_message: Your travel briefing, weather notice, and hotel archive are ready.
